newsitem.title: POLAND: Foreign investment in Poland exceeds $11 bln.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment in Poland exceeds $11 bln.

text.p: Foreign direct investment in Poland increased by about $4 billion in 1996, pushing the amount attracted since 1990 to more than $11 billion, the government's Foreign Investment Agency (PAIZ) said on Tuesaday.
"Foreign investment in Poland reached approximately $11 billion, which means that it increased by about $4 billion in 1996," Robert Seges, a PAIZ research department official, told Reuters.
Foreign investment was led by U.S. companies, which invested $2.33 billion by July 1996. Multi-national corporations followed with $1.47 billion.
Germany was third with investment of $1.34 billion, followed by Italy at $953 million, the Netherlands at $839 million and France with $657 million.
